item.title: CobaltC – The Successor to C?
item.description:

Generic Types Generic types and functions are statically checked.

item.title: Why do I lose my passion and want to do nothing?
item.description:
📝 Taking on more ambitious projects. I used to think about side projects I could complete in days, and now I think more about projects I can complete in months. With AI, days have become hours and months have become days, so I simply try to think of projects that would have taken me a long time before.
🔗 Read more: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49505014
